verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine, and batch or bulk processing is a fair question for that kind of product. The evidence pack shows only single-request usage: one-shot chat, a single OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, and a model fetch script. Nothing documents processing many items or prompts in one operation, and one base model serving multiple adapter sets is a different feature, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
